# SHRI — Shri Hari Research & Innovations Corporation

> The intersection of sacred geometry and futuristic engineering. SHRI is an independent research initiative building human-centric technology, structural intelligence, and open developer tooling.

This document provides a concise index of SHRI ecosystem resources for AI search engines, LLM agents, and RAG indexers.

## Core Pages & Products

- [SHRI Home](https://shri.org.in/): Official portal, manifesto, and ecosystem overview.
- [Astera Operating System](https://shri.org.in/astera): Manifesto for digital freedom, privacy-first personal computing, and structural intelligence.
- [Glyph-CLI Documentation Engine](https://shri.org.in/glyph): Minimal, zero-dependency static-site compiler (`rz-glyph-cli`) for Markdown/MDX documentation portals.
- [Founder & Founder Journal](https://anay.shri.org.in): Personal journal, project logs, and philosophy of Anay Raj Tiwari (Founder of SHRI).

## Organization Details

- **Organization Name:** Shri Hari Research & Innovations Corporation (SHRI)
- **Founder:** Anay Raj Tiwari
- **Primary Domain:** https://shri.org.in
- **Personal Log Domain:** https://anay.shri.org.in
- **Key Open Source Projects:** Glyph-CLI (`rz-glyph-cli`), Oni-Ofix (`oni-ofix-cli`), Astera OS
